title: Visual Editor Enhancements: overview film
description: An element library, a popover and link editing. A narrated tour, recorded in this TYPO3 v14 lab, with English captions.
alt: Overview film, 51 seconds: Visual Editor Enhancements for TYPO3 v14. Search that forgives typos; Layout options in a popover; A toolbar that stays on screen; Edit a link where it sits. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: The Visual Editor lets editors type on the page. Layout options, links and new elements still mean the backend form.
Visual Editor Enhancements adds what editors miss on the page.
The element library shows live previews, and a typo like testimonal still finds testimonials.
Layout options open in a popover, grouped like the backend form.
The rich-text toolbar sits in one row above the text.
Hover a button, and a chain icon opens the link browser.
Everything saves through the Visual Editor.
